Class AetherisNotebookPanel.RustLetterFace

org.aetheris.swing.AetherisNotebookPanel.RustLetterFace
Enclosing class:
AetherisNotebookPanel
private static final class AetherisNotebookPanel.RustLetterFace extends BasicButtonUI
The RustLetterFace paints a one-letter mark. The paint order is the fill, then the white stroke, then the letter. The letter stays visible. The type extends BasicButtonUI so a button can install this face.

  • Method Details

    • installDefaults

      protected void installDefaults(AbstractButton b)
      The method installs a flat button and then clears the chrome this face does not use. The button is not opaque. The button does not fill its content area. The button does not paint a focus ring. The border and the margin are empty. The text-shift offset is 0.
      Overrides:
      installDefaults in class BasicButtonUI
      Parameters:
      b - the button that is installing this face

    • paint

      public void paint(Graphics g, JComponent c)
      The method paints the parent plate, the rounded fill, the white stroke, and the letter. A width under 1 or a height under 1 returns before any paint. Antialiasing is on for the copy of g. The parent background fills the whole rectangle when the parent has a background. The button background fills a round rectangle whose corner arcs are 4 by 4. Those arcs are a corner radius of 2. The white stroke is one pixel and uses a corner arc of 3. The letter is centered. A missing foreground color is painted as white. The graphics copy is disposed.
      Overrides:
      paint in class BasicButtonUI
      Parameters:
      g - the graphics Swing passed for this button
      c - the button component, cast to AbstractButton
